description:
### PixelBoard Patches (v1.2.0)

* **Features Menu Accessibility**: Fixed TalkBack focus navigation and window state announcement when expanding keyboard access points
* **Dictation JNI Readiness for Fused APKs**: Direct JNI library loading verification for fused APKs without Play split markers
* **Clipboard & Screenshot Auto-Sync**: Instant clipboard and screenshot paste suggestions via foreground observer sync and XML preference defaults
* **Sign-to-Text (ASL Translation)**: Unlocked native camera Signboard gesture recognition to translate American Sign Language
* **Smart Auto-Correction & Dynamic Revert**: Pre-enabled auto-correction with primary-key revert and fine-tuned word learning threshold
* **Updated High-Resolution App Icon**: Official high-resolution Material You adaptive app icon and monochrome vector theme drawable across all densities
* **Gemini Rambler Voice Dictation**: Fixed official selector hooks, standalone APK default (enable_jetson), and suppressed compliance feedback access point icon
* **Super Insert Android 16 Crash Fix**: Guarded against unsupported PersonalContext hint APIs on Android 16 (API 36)
* **Modern Spell Checker Suggestion Chips & Grammar Checking**: Enforced Android 12+ inline spell checker suggestion chips and add-to-dictionary UI across all devices
* **Scan Text / Camera OCR**: Unlocked Gboard Scan Text camera OCR feature and camera permission for real-time text recognition across all languages
* **Screenshot / Floating Image Banner**: Unlocked floating screenshot chip and media paste flow with image permissions
* **Emoji Palette V2 & Dedicated Tabs**: Modern emoji drawer layout with frequent emoji recent tabs and customizable grid density
* **Super Insert & Smart Compose**: Unlocked rich multi-view super insert, contact results, and in-line ghost autocompletion
* **Contextual Emoji Suggestions**: Activated Delight5 concept prediction engine and emoji shortcut candidates
* **Material 3 Expressive Rounded Keys**: Material 3 Belka rounded pill keycaps (#14)
* **Samsung & Vivo Clipboard History Sync**: Foreground clipboard sync fix (#17)
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with stock Gboard

Supports Gboard v18.4.1 (Release) and v18.3.1 (Release / Beta).
